JSON content is parsed and reserialized; numbers, hashes, outcomes and capture times are unchanged. Each raw_sha256 identifies the private retained original bytes, not these redacted contents.

"""Actual CLI with an operator-controlled native filesystem publication fault."""
import datetime,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,signal,stat,subprocess,sys,time
source=pathlib.Path('<SOURCE_REPO>')
out=source/'.ai-dlc/local/q01-native-extra-189913b/recovery';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
project=out/'project';bundle=out/'bundle-source';bundle.mkdir()
env={k:os.environ[k] for k in ('PATH','HOME','LANG','TMPDIR') if k in os.environ}
env.update(PYTHONPATH=str(source/'src'),PYTHONNOUSERSITE='1',GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='/dev/null',GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1',GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0',GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL='file')
for key in ('XDG_CONFIG_HOME','XDG_CACHE_HOME','XDG_STATE_HOME','XDG_DATA_HOME'):
 p=out/key.lower();p.mkdir();env[key]=str(p)
rows=[]
def save(name,value):(out/name).write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n')
def now():return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
def run(label,args,cwd=out):
 start=now(); t=time.monotonic();r=subprocess.run([str(x) for x in args],cwd=cwd,env=env,capture_output=True,timeout=120)
 (out/(label+'.stdout')).write_bytes(r.stdout);(out/(label+'.stderr')).write_bytes(r.stderr)
 rows.append(dict(label=label,argv=[str(x) for x in args],cwd=str(cwd),started_at=start,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-t,exit_code=r.returncode));save('commands.json',rows);print(label,r.returncode,flush=True)
 if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(label)
 return r
cli=[sys.executable,'-m','ai_dlc']
run('engine-revision',['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],source);run('engine-status',['git','status','--porcelain'],source)
run('adopt',cli+['project','adopt','--root',project,'--preset','generic','--tracker','github-issues','--apply'])
(project/'authored-sentinel.txt').write_text('Authored qualification sentinel, preserve exact bytes.\n')
run('bundle-init',['git','init'],bundle)
url='https://q01.example.invalid/recovery.git'
env.update(GIT_CONFIG_COUNT='1',GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=f'url.{bundle.as_uri()}.insteadOf',GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=url)
def digest(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def version(n):
 files={};templates={}
 for i in range(500):
  name=f'templates/item-{i:03d}.md';p=bundle/name;p.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
  content=(f'# Controlled qualification template {i}, version {n}\n'+('local content without provider or user data\n'*280)).encode();p.write_bytes(content);files[name]=digest(content);templates[f'item-{i:03d}']=name
 (bundle/'bundle.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(schema=1,id='q01-recovery',skills={},templates=templates,files=files),indent=2)+'\n')
 run(f'bundle-add-{n}',['git','add','.'],bundle);run(f'bundle-commit-{n}',['git','-c','user.name=Qualification Operator','-c','user.email=qualification@example.invalid','commit','-m',f'Controlled v{n}'],bundle)
 rev=run(f'bundle-revision-{n}',['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],bundle).stdout.decode().strip();run(f'bundle-tag-{n}',['git','tag',f'v{n}'],bundle);return rev
v1=version(1)
run('import-v1',cli+['agents','bundle','import',url,'--ref','v1','--id','q01-recovery','--root',project,'--apply','--expected-commit',v1])
v2=version(2)
def snapshot(root):
 return {str(p.relative_to(root)):{'sha256':digest(p.read_bytes()),'size':p.stat().st_size} for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and '.git' not in p.relative_to(root).parts}
active=project/'.ai-dlc/bundles/q01-recovery';parent=active.parent
before=snapshot(project);old=snapshot(active);save('project-before.json',before);save('active-before.json',old)
args=[str(x) for x in cli+['agents','bundle','import',url,'--ref','v2','--id','q01-recovery','--root',project,'--apply','--expected-commit',v2]]
events=[];stage=None;paused=False
with (out/'failed-update.stdout').open('wb') as stdout,(out/'failed-update.stderr').open('wb') as stderr:
 start=now();t=time.monotonic();process=subprocess.Popen(args,cwd=out,env=env,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr)
 try:
  deadline=time.monotonic()+90
  while process.poll() is None and time.monotonic()<deadline:
   backups=list(parent.glob('.q01-recovery.backup-*'))
   if backups:
    os.kill(process.pid,signal.SIGSTOP);paused=True
    # Wait for the owned child to enter the OS stopped state before inspecting it.
    _,status=os.waitpid(process.pid,os.WUNTRACED)
    if not os.WIFSTOPPED(status):raise RuntimeError('Expected child stop')
    events.append(dict(event='owned CLI stopped after backup appeared',time=now(),pid=process.pid,backup_names=[p.name for p in backups],active_exists=active.exists()))
    stages=list(parent.glob('.q01-recovery.stage-*'))
    if len(stages)!=1 or active.exists():raise RuntimeError('Missed prepublication boundary; do not inject')
    stage=stages[0];save('stage-before-fault.json',snapshot(stage));save('backup-at-fault.json',snapshot(backups[0]))
    assert snapshot(backups[0])==old
    os.chflags(stage,stage.stat().st_flags|stat.UF_IMMUTABLE)
    events.append(dict(event='operator marked complete staged directory user-immutable',time=now(),path=str(stage),flags=stage.stat().st_flags))
    os.kill(process.pid,signal.SIGCONT);paused=False;events.append(dict(event='owned CLI resumed',time=now()))
    break
   time.sleep(.0002)
  code=process.wait(timeout=90)
 finally:
  if paused:os.kill(process.pid,signal.SIGCONT)
  if process.poll() is None:
   process.terminate();process.wait(timeout=10)
 events.append(dict(event='owned CLI exited',time=now(),exit_code=code))
 rows.append(dict(label='failed-update',argv=args,cwd=str(out),started_at=start,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-t,exit_code=code));save('commands.json',rows);save('fault-events.json',events)
print('failed-update',code,flush=True)
after=snapshot(project);save('project-after-failure.json',after);save('active-after-failure.json',snapshot(active) if active.exists() else {})
residue=sorted(p.name for p in parent.iterdir() if p.name!='q01-recovery')
comparison=dict(exit_code=code,original_active_bytes_restored=active.exists() and snapshot(active)==old,retained_paths=residue,project_paths_changed=[p for p in before.keys()|after.keys() if before.get(p)!=after.get(p)],stage_flags=stage.stat().st_flags if stage and stage.exists() else None)
save('failure-comparison.json',comparison)
assert code!=0 and comparison['original_active_bytes_restored'] and stage and stage.exists()
assert 'retained' in (out/'failed-update.stderr').read_text().lower()
# Explicit operator recovery removes only its own flag on its verified stage; no paths deleted.
os.chflags(stage,stage.stat().st_flags & ~stat.UF_IMMUTABLE)
save('operator-recovery.json',{'time':now(),'action':'Removed only the user-immutable flag applied by this probe; retained all paths','path':str(stage)})
run('retry-update',cli+['agents','bundle','import',url,'--ref','v2','--id','q01-recovery','--root',project,'--apply','--expected-commit',v2])
save('active-after-retry.json',snapshot(active));save('project-after-retry.json',snapshot(project))
assert json.loads((active/'bundle.lock.json').read_text())['resolved_commit']==v2
save('method.json',{'source_revision':'189913b6cfc2c42828e35f4e2755c982b7f1e2da','v1':v1,'v2':v2,'source_routing':{'declared':url,'actual':bundle.as_uri(),'protocol':'file only'},'environment':{k:v for k,v in env.items() if k.startswith('XDG_')},'classification':'live-local actual CLI on existing Darwin arm64 host','fault':'Operator paused owned CLI after its real backup rename, set user-immutable flag on the complete staged directory, and resumed; no production failure hook, service mock or internal import.','limitations':['Controlled local filesystem failure, not spontaneous field failure.','No installed-tree drift, failed backup authentication or incomplete restoration case executed.','No provider, model-client, factory-clean or OS-wide network-block qualification.']})
